exposure: Clinician-initiated obstetric intervention (labor induction or prelabor cesarean delivery)
cohort: Singleton live births from 2006 to the latest available year (ranging from 2010 to 2015) in Canada, Denmark, Finland, Norway, Sweden, and the United States
finding: Between 2006 and 2014/2015, late preterm and early term birth rates decreased in the United States, with an association observed between early term births and decreasing clinician-initiated obstetric interventions.
country: Canada, Denmark, Finland, Norway, Sweden, and the United States
gest_age: Late preterm (34-36 weeks) and early term (37-38 weeks)
